Let us find the number of people who came in physical contact with TinkaNupoor on various given days:

Tuesday = 24% of 900 = 216

Thursday = 15% of 900 = 135
Friday = 27% of 900 = 243
Only 40% of 900 were found positive on tests on Tuesday, thus 40% of 900 = 360 were found positive.

Each of whom came in contact with an average of 12 people each day. Thus in three days, they would have come in contact with 3 × 12 = 36 people.
There were 360 people, so all would have come in contact with 36x360 people
Only 45% of these were found positive, thus = 45% of 36 × 360 = 5832
Hence, the correct answer is 5832.

The investment of Dharam = 10% of 160000
Reqd. % = {15 – 10} × 160000 × 100
10 × 160000
= (5 / 10) × 100 = 50% more
Hence, the correct answer is 50% more.
